typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Facility_Id__c as string,
		Name as string,
		Type__c as string,
		Street__c as string,
		Street2__c as string,
		City__c as string,
		State__c as string,
		Postal_Code__c as string,
		County__c as string,
		Phone_Number__c as string,
		Notes__c as string,
		Seating_Capacity__c as string,
		LastModifiedDate as string,
		Venue_Type_Other__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['salesforce/ob_kpma_meeting_venue_audit*']) ~> source1
source1 select(mapColumn(
		FACILITY_UID = Facility_Id__c,
		{FACILITY NAME} = Name,
		{VENUE TYPE} = Type__c,
		ADDRESS1 = Street__c,
		ADDRESS2 = Street2__c,
		CITY = City__c,
		STATE = State__c,
		ZIP = Postal_Code__c,
		{ZIP+4} = Postal_Code__c,
		COUNTY = County__c,
		{VENUE PHONE} = Phone_Number__c,
		{VENUE NOTES} = Notes__c,
		{VENUE CAPACITY} = Seating_Capacity__c,
		STATUS = LastModifiedDate,
		{VENUE TYPE} = Venue_Type_Other__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('ob_kpma_meeting_venue_audit_', toString(currentUTC(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
